children: As financial institutions face growing regulatory complexity, increasing data demands, and pressure to do more with fewer resources,
today announced significant enhancements to its

, including the introduction of Performance Analytics Wiz®. The expanded platform helps banks and credit unions move beyond fragmented compliance processes by connecting data, workflows, analytics, and reporting into a centralized compliance ecosystem.

For more than three decades, financial institutions have relied on Wolters Kluwer's Wiz Suite to help navigate evolving regulatory obligations. Today's enhancements build on that foundation with greater automation, analytics, and flexibility to support the future of compliance management.
Compliance analytics for the modern bank
"Financial institutions are increasingly looking for ways to transform compliance from a periodic reporting exercise into a strategic business function," said

, Vice President, Banking Compliance Solutions, Wolters Kluwer Financial & Corporate Compliance. "With the introduction of Performance Analytics Wiz and expanded capabilities across Wiz, we're helping institutions gain continuous insight into their compliance and overall business performance, reduce operational complexity, and create a more connected foundation for managing regulatory obligations and driving future growth."
Updates to the Wiz Suite include:
Performance Analytics Wiz®:

Delivers continuous visibility into Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) performance through automated measurement, standardized scoring, actionable insights, and real-time analytics. By turning compliance data into a clear view of performance trends and opportunities, institutions can identify emerging gaps earlier, track progress throughout the evaluation period, and shift from retrospective reporting to proactive performance management and strategic decision-making.
Community Development Wiz®:

Digitizes and centralizes the management of community development loans, investments, services, grants, and supporting documentation within a single system of record. New enhancements, including a centralized document repository, configurable workflows, custom templates, record duplication, and flexible data capture, help institutions improve operational efficiency, strengthen audit readiness, and more effectively demonstrate community impact during examinations.
Wiz bundled package offerings

: Provides financial institutions with a scalable path to modernize compliance management through an integrated suite of solutions built on a common data framework. Organizations can address immediate compliance priorities while establishing a foundation for future growth, reducing operational silos, streamlining workflows, and increasing consistency across CRA, HMDA, Fair Lending, Community Development, and Section 1071 programs.
Building a connected compliance foundation

The expanded Wiz Suite helps institutions replace disconnected spreadsheets, manual processes, and siloed systems with an integrated compliance management framework. By providing a single source of truth for compliance data, the platform enables more efficient reporting, stronger governance, and continuous readiness for regulatory examinations.

Trusted by more than 500 banks and credit unions and seven of the top 10 U.S. financial institutions, the Wiz Suite enables institutions to streamline compliance processes, increase visibility into performance, and maintain year-round examination readiness.
To learn more about why US banks and credit unions rely on the Wiz Suite, visit: https://www.wolterskluwer.com/en/solutions/wiz.
About Wolters Kluwer

Wolters Kluwer (EURONEXT: WKL) is a global leader in information solutions, software and services for professionals in healthcare; tax and accounting; financial and corporate compliance; legal and regulatory; corporate performance and ESG. We help our customers make critical decisions every day by providing
expert solutions
that combine deep domain knowledge with technology and services.

Wolters Kluwer reported 2025 annual revenues of €6.1 billion. The group serves customers in over 180 countries, maintains operations in over 40 countries, and employs approximately 21,100 people worldwide. The company is headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands.

Wolters Kluwer shares are listed on Euronext Amsterdam (WKL) and are included in the AEX, Euro Stoxx 50, and Euronext 100 indices. Wolters Kluwer has a sponsored Level 1 American Depositary Receipt (ADR) program. The ADRs are traded on the over-the-counter market in the U.S. (WTKWY).
For more information, visit www.wolterskluwer.com, follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and Instagram.
